title: Rethinking Benchmark Comparability: A Survey of Reasoning Benchmarks for Large Language Models
best_for_zh: 选择、构建或解读推理基准与数据的读者。
one_line: A 2026 survey that explains why two “reasoning benchmark” scores are often not measuring the same thing.
解释推理基准分数为何常常不可直接比较的 2026 综述。
why: It turns benchmark selection from leaderboard following into a concrete comparison of capability, conditions, and metric.
inclusion_reason: A 2026 survey focused directly on the data and measurement conditions behind reasoning benchmark scores.

title: Problem
问题
html: Reasoning benchmarks are plentiful, but their scores often look more comparable than they are. One benchmark may test symbolic deduction from a fixed prompt; another may allow retrieval, tools, images, long context, or repeated attempts. Their answer keys and success criteria can differ as well. This 2026 survey addresses that mismatch. It treats a benchmark instance as more than a question and answer: it has a capability target, a setting that shapes what the model can do, and an evaluation rule that gives the score meaning.
推理基准很多，但它们的分数往往比看上去更难比较。一个基准可能测试固定提示下的符号推导；另一个可能允许检索、工具、图像、长上下文或多次尝试，答案键和成功标准也可能不同。这篇 2026 综述处理的正是这种错配。它认为一个基准样本不只是问题和答案：还包括能力目标、塑造模型行为的设置，以及赋予分数意义的评测规则。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The survey’s central framework has three questions. Object: what reasoning capability is being tested? Setting: which inputs, tools, budgets, and environmental conditions are available? Evaluation: what does the metric actually count as success? Put these three fields next to every benchmark score. If any field changes, an apparent improvement may reflect a different task contract rather than a stronger model. This is a direct lesson for reasoning-data work: data design and scoring cannot be separated from the behavior a benchmark claims to measure.
综述的核心框架有三个问题。Object：测试的是什么推理能力？Setting：可用哪些输入、工具、预算和环境条件？Evaluation：指标究竟把什么算作成功？应把这三项放在每个基准分数旁边。只要其中一项改变，表面提升就可能意味着任务约定变了，而不是模型更强。这对推理数据工作是直接提醒：数据设计和评分不能同基准声称测量的行为分开。

title: Method
方法
html: The paper synthesizes benchmarks through Object, Setting, and Evaluation instead of proposing a new model. To apply it, build a short record for every candidate benchmark. State the dependency structure a solver must preserve, the context and actions it receives, and the exact success rule. Add freshness, possible overlap with training data, and the reporting protocol. This makes two hidden choices visible: whether a model may obtain extra evidence, and whether a final answer is enough when the task is supposed to test multi-step reasoning.
论文用 Object、Setting 和 Evaluation 综合基准，而不是提出新模型。应用时，为每个候选基准建立简短记录：写清求解器必须保持的依赖结构、收到的上下文和动作权限，以及精确成功规则；再补充新鲜度、与训练数据可能重叠的情况和报告协议。这样能看见两个常被隐藏的选择：模型能否获得额外证据，以及当任务声称测试多步推理时，最终答案是否足够。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The official abstract supports a benchmark-comparison framework, not a replacement leaderboard. It surveys reasoning benchmarks and identifies heterogeneous target objects and weakly justified settings as major barriers to direct comparison. That claim is useful because it tells readers what to inspect before averaging scores. A result is most informative when it reports the benchmark version, prompt and tool conditions, model sampling settings, grading code, and more than one diagnostic measurement where the task has several ways to fail.
官方摘要支持的是基准比较框架，而不是替代排行榜。它综述推理基准，并将异质的目标对象和缺少充分说明的设置视为直接比较的主要障碍。这个主张的价值在于，它告诉读者平均分之前该检查什么。一个结果在报告基准版本、提示与工具条件、模型采样设置、评分代码，并在任务有多种失败方式时提供多个诊断测量时，信息量最大。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Many benchmark surveys sort datasets by subject area or modality. This paper instead separates the thing being measured from the conditions that elicit it and the metric that summarizes it. The distinction is small on paper but consequential in practice. A math benchmark with a calculator is not the same measurement as the same questions without one; a tool agent judged only by the final string is not fully measured as an agent. The contribution is a sharper comparison unit for reasoning claims.
许多基准综述按学科或模态整理数据集。这篇论文则把被测量的对象、激发该行为的条件，以及概括结果的指标分开。这个区别写起来很小，实际影响却很大：带计算器的数学基准，和同样题目但没有计算器的设置，不是同一种测量；只按最终字符串评分的工具智能体，也没有被完整地作为智能体测量。贡献在于为推理主张提供更精确的比较单位。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The framework improves description, but it cannot make incompatible studies compatible by itself. Some capabilities are difficult to define independently of the environment; some realistic settings necessarily change over time; and richer metric panels require more annotation or verification work. The survey is also a preprint, so treat its recommendations as a useful lens rather than settled standard. For any benchmark you adopt, inspect its released examples and scorer rather than inferring its behavior from a taxonomy label.
该框架改进了描述，却不能自动让不兼容的研究变得可比。有些能力很难脱离环境独立定义；有些真实设置必然随时间变化；更丰富的指标面板也需要更多标注或验证工作。论文还是预印本，因此应把建议当作有用视角，而不是既定标准。采用任一基准时，应查看发布样例和评分器，而不要从一个分类标签推断它的行为。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper before selecting a benchmark for a reasoning-data project. Begin with the deployment failure you need to expose, then choose an Object, Setting, and Evaluation that can expose it. For example, if the concern is evidence-grounded reasoning, a final-answer-only score is incomplete; if the concern is efficient planning, a task without a budget cannot answer it. The framework helps students produce a compact benchmark brief that is much more actionable than “use the popular leaderboard.”
在为推理数据项目选择基准前可先用这篇论文。从需要暴露的部署失败开始，再选择能暴露它的 Object、Setting 和 Evaluation。例如，若关心基于证据的推理，只看最终答案分数并不完整；若关心高效规划，没有预算的任务也回答不了问题。这个框架能帮助学生写出紧凑的基准说明，比“使用热门排行榜”更可执行。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the three dimensions first and immediately test them on one benchmark you already know. Try to write a one-sentence Object, a precise Setting, and a literal Evaluation rule. If you cannot, the benchmark documentation is not yet sufficient for a strong comparison. Then read the discussions of freshness, evidence, and broader scenarios. Keep the final lesson: a benchmark score is not a property of a model alone; it is an outcome of a model interacting with a specified dataset, protocol, and scoring semantics.
建议先读三个维度，并立刻用一个熟悉的基准测试它们。尝试写出一句话的 Object、精确的 Setting 和字面化的 Evaluation 规则；若写不出来，基准文档就还不足以支持强比较。然后再读新鲜度、证据和更广泛场景的讨论。最后记住：基准分数不是模型单独拥有的属性，而是模型同指定数据、协议和评分语义互动的结果。
